messages.subject: 99 applications
parts:
Hi all

This year we have 99 applications to review.

I would like to suggest a preliminary review of applications due in 1 week.
In this preliminary review, I would ask mentors to briefly review the applications submitted for their ideas, in order to determine which applications can be ignored / may be spam or AI generated.

Please send your opinion of which applications should be ignored to one of the admins (Toby, Brian, Narayani, Vijay) by April 17.

Thanks
Toby
